reason: mutant !note.is_empty() instead of note.contains(path) now fails atip_checkl2safety_05 (an effectNote that exists and does not name the file)
summary: Standards (mutation probe of the new owner; checker.md 1.3.1 L2.idempotency: a path matching allowedEffects is left out only when the effectNote NAMES that side effect; section 7.2 row 'the same, with an effectNote that does not name the file' fails L2.idempotency): the condition is `run.note.contains(path)` (safety.rs:139). Replacing it with `!note.is_empty()` SURVIVES all 18 atip_checkl2safety tests: no case has an effectNote that exists but does not name the file (the `**` case has no note at all), so the seeded row 4 of 7.2 is not seeded. I probed it black-box with stampAudit: a note that names the file passes and lists the path, a note that does not name it fails, no allowedEffects fails; so the behaviour is right and unproven. Fix: a docPatch case on `stamp` that sets /effectNote to a sentence without the file and asserts L2.idempotency fails alone. Also say in `atip check --help` what 'names' means (substring of the path as the checker records it; a note that says 'an audit line' without the path fails).
